chapter.verse: Tu-in Judea gam pan mi kimkhat hong paisukin sanggamte' kiangah, “Moses ngeina bangin vun na ki-at kei uhleh hotkhiat na ngah theikei ding uh hi,” ci-in hilhcian uh hi.

Tua ciangin Paul leh Barnabas zong amaute tawh thu kinialna leh thu a maanzaw kituhna nakpi nei uh a, tua khit ciangin hih thubuai huhau-in Jerusalem khua sawltakte leh makaite' kiangah a va pai dingin Paul, Barnabas leh a dangte kimkhat kiseh hi.
Tua ciangin pawlpi in amaute kha a, amau zong Phoenicia leh Samaria gam nih a nawk kawmun Gentile mite' kikhelna thu cingtak sutkikin sanggamte khempeuh' tungah nuamna lianpi tun uh hi.
Jerusalem a tun uh ciangin pawlpi leh sawltakte leh makaite in na muak uh a, amaute in zong amau' tungtawna Pasian' sep thute khempeuh zasak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pharisee pawlke sunga kihel thu-um mi kimkhat dingto uh a, “Amaute vun a at nadingun leh Moses' thukhun a zuih nadingun thupiak ding kisam hi,” ci uh hi.
Hih thu a van dingin sawltakte leh makaite kituahkhawm uh hi.

Kinialna nakpi a om khit ciangin Peter dingto-in amaute' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Sanggamte aw, a beisa hun lai-in Pasian in note' lakah tenkhiatna khat a bawlna thu na theih uh hi a, kei' kam tungtawnin Gentile mite in Lungdamna Thu za-in a up theih nading cih thu ahi hi.
Tua ciangin lungsim a thei Pasian in eite' tunga hong sep bang lianin amaute' tungah Kha Siangtho a piakna tawh teci pang a,
upna tungtawnin amaute' lungsim siansuahin amau leh ei' kikal ah deidanna hong nei lo hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in i pupite hitaleh eite mahmah in hitaleh i puak zawhloh hakkol khat nungzuite' liangko ah suatna tawh bang hangin Pasian zia-et ding na hi uh hiam?
Amaute mah bangin eite zong Topa Jesu' hehpihna hangin hotkhiat i ngah ding hi ci-in ko ka um uh hi.”
Tua ciangin mipite a vekun gamdai uh a, Barnabas leh Paul ii gen, amau' tungtawna piang Gentile mite' laka Pasian' bawl kihilna lim lamdang thute ngai uh hi.
A thugen uh a man ciangin James in hih bangin dawng hi: “Sanggamte aw, ka thugen na ngai un.
Gentile mite' kiangah Pasian va hawh masa-in tua mite' sungpan ama' min' ading mipawl a tuam khat a tenkhiatna thu Simeon in hong gentel khinzo hi.
Tua pen kamsangte' thugen teng tawh zong kituak hi:
“‘Hih thute khit, kei kilehin a puksa David' puanbuk ka lamkik ding a, a kisiazan teng puahpha-in ka phutkik ding hi.
Tua pen mihing a omlai teng leh keima' min tawh a kisam Gentile mite khempeuh in Topa a zon nading uh ahi hi, ci-in
Topa in sawtpi lai pek pan hong theikhiasak hi.’
Tua ahih manin kei' ngaihsutna ah eite in Pasian' lama hong kihei tua Gentile mite i va nawngkaisak ding sangin
milim hanga a thanghuai nate, nulepa tatkhialhna, tawl-atloh sa, leh sisan, cihte a pelh a tan nading uh lai khak-huaizaw ka sa hi.
A hang pen tanglai pek panin khua khempeuh ah Moses' thukhun a tangko mi om den a, Sabbath nisimin vengkhawm innte ah tua thu a gingin kisimkhia hi.”

Tua ciangin sawltakte leh makaite-a kipan pawlpi bup in Antioch ah Paul leh Barnabas tawh a sawlkhop dingun amaute' lakpan mi tenkhiat ding hoih sa uh hi. Tua ciangin sanggamte lakah a makai pawl ahi Barsabbas minnei Judas leh Silas, sawlkhia uh hi.
Laikhak khat zong puasak uh a, hih bangin kigelh hi: “Sawltakte leh makaite ahi sanggam teng in Antioch, Syria leh Cilicia khua-a Gentile mi sanggamte kong hopih uh hi.
Komau' thupiakna om lo pi-in ko' kiangpan mi kimkhat hong kuankhia uh a, thugenna tawh na lungsim uh hong buaisakin note hong lungmangsak cih thu na za khin ka hih manun
ka it uh Barnabas leh Paul tawh kong sawlkhop dingun mi tengkhia ding cih lungsim kikhatin hoih ka sa uh hi.
Barnabas leh Paul pen i Topa Jesu Khris' min' ading a nuntakna uh a pia ngamte ahi uh hi.
Tua hangin Judas leh Silas kong sawl uh a, amaute in hih thute mah kam tawh hong gen ding uh hi.
A hang pen note' tungah a nuai-a thukalhte sang a lianzaw vangik suat loh dingin Kha Siangtho leh kote in hoih ka sa uh hi.
Milim thoihna an, sisan, tawl-atloh sa, nulepa tatkhialhna cihte na peel na tang un. Hihte pan na kikep uhleh a hoih-a gamta na hi uh hi. Dam tek ni.”
Tua bangin a kisawl ciangin amaute zong Antioch ah pai uh a, thu-um mite kaikhawmin tua laikhak ap uh hi.
Lai a sim khit uh ciangin thangahhuai thu hangin amaute lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin kamsang mah ahi Judas leh Silas in thugenna saupi tawh sanggamte hanthawnin thakhauhsak uh hi.
Tawlkhat sung a taam khit uh ciangin sanggamte in zinte gel amau a sawlkhiate' kiangah lungnuamtak ciahsak uh hi.
(Ahi zongin Judas bek ciahin Silas taamsuak hi.)
Ahih hangin Paul leh Barnabas ahihleh Antioch ah taamsuak uh a, midang tampi tawh kithuahin Topa' thu hilhcianin Lungdamna Thu tangko uh hi.
Tawlkhat khit ciangin Paul in Barnabas' kiangah, “Tu-in ei kilehkikin Topa' thu i va pulakna khuapi citeng ah sanggamte bangcici uh cih va van ni,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Barnabas in Mark kici John tonpih nuam hi.
Ahih hangin Paul in nasepna ah amaute tawh kithuah lo-in Pamphylia ah amaute a nusia ngei khat tonpih loh hoihpen dingin ngaihsun hi.
Tua ciangin thu kituahlohna nakpi piang ahih manin amaute gel kikhenlawh uh a, Barnabas in Mark tonpihin tembaw tawh Cyprus zuan hi.
Paul ahihleh Silas teel a, sanggamte in Topa' hehpihna sungah a ap khit uh ciangin kuankhia hi.
Syria leh Cilicia gam teng ah pai-in pawlpite thakhauhsak hi.
